gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed recurrent glioblastoma (grade IV) as per WHO criteria 2021 (IDH- wild type only)

candidate_evidence.quote: Phase I open-label trial of 123I-ATT001 monotherapy and in combination with treatment therapies in subjects with relapsed glioblastoma.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Phase 1 Open-label Study of 123I-ATT001 in Subjects With Relapsed Glioblastoma

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Part 1 - Dose Escalation: biodistribution and pharmacokinetics of 123I-ATT001 in blood: Blood samples will be collected from the first 6 patients in Part 1.

role_evidence.quote: In Part 1 participants will receive a 123I-ATT001 dose, once per week, for four weeks (+ two optional extra cycles).

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational iodine-123 (Auger emitter) labelled PARP1 inhibitor radioconjugate, administered intralesionally via Ommaya reservoir
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: I-123 labelled poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase 1 inhibitor delivering radiation to tumour cells

source_quote.quote: Histologically confirmed recurrent glioblastoma (grade IV) as per WHO criteria 2021 (IDH- wild type only)

coder_notes: Radiopharmaceutical named per W1 without isotope (att001); isotope I-123 in drug_class_hint. Directly administered into intralesional cavity via Ommaya reservoir -> formulation_flag new_route; Ommaya reservoir not treated as device-enabled delivery (device_dependent false), adjudicator may differ. Part 2 combination therapies not yet specified (to be added by amendment), so not listed. PK in blood/urine only; SPECT dosimetry is organ radiation exposure, not tumour drug concentration. IDH-wildtype only defines GBM.
